items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: I know he used to play with my grandfather, but I never seen him. I met his mother and his sisters

ctx.x: See like Alfred played? Uh huh. Same type of drummer. Steady, huh? Steady drummer. Then he could play a nice violin. His father was a musician. Could draw notes man. Looked like he'd come out to print. Uh huh. Mr. Welch. Was he a trumpet player, was it that one? was it that one? I can't remember. I don't know what Joe Welson's father played, because I know he used to play with my grandfather, but I never seen him. I met his mother and his sisters, and I know when they first set the union up here, he was…
Yeah, he was one of the best around here. I only knew him as a trumpet player. He used to take him trumpet after. Who was your trumpet player in your band?
